commit.message:
feat(tools): export and import the document's tools as a tool library file

The Tool library page gains "Export library..." and "Import library...".
Export writes every document tool as camcraft-tools/1 JSON ({format,
version, units: mm, tools: [{name, definition}]}), each definition the
exact tool shape MCP's get_job/add_tool and the project file already use.
Import (app::tool_library::parse_tool_library + commands::ImportTools) is
one undo unit: the whole file is validated first - malformed JSON, a
wrong format/version, a missing field, a name twice, a reserved name or a
tool Tool::is_sane refuses each refuse the import by tool name with
nothing applied. A name already in the document is never overwritten: an
identical tool is skipped, a different one comes in as "<name> (2)".
Vendor library formats stay out of scope (clean-room).

Refs #300

feat(mcp): export_tool_library and import_tool_library tools

The MCP server gains export_tool_library {path} and import_tool_library
{path}, re-dressing two new job-script verbs, cam.exportTools(path) and
cam.importTools(path) (VERBS table + assets/scripts/cam.d.ts), so the
batch and MCP lanes keep one meaning per verb. Export writes the GUI's
own camcraft-tools/1 file (tool_library::export_tool_library); import
runs parse_tool_library + ImportTools through the session History, so
the duplicate skip, the "Name (2)" rename, the refusal of a malformed or
insane file by name and the one-undo-step law are #300's.

Pinned in tests/mcp.rs (tools/list schemas, roundtrip into a fresh
document, duplicate skip and rename, malformed refusal, undo/redo) and
tests/scripting.rs (the verbs).

Fixes #355

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(tools): an exported tool library always carries the .camtools suffix

Hands-on finding (macOS): the save panel suggests tools.camtools, but a
typed name without a suffix was written as is - macOS does not enforce
an unknown extension - so the library landed with no suffix. Export now
appends .camtools when the chosen name has no extension; a name that
already has one (.camtools, or a deliberate .json) is kept as typed.

Pinned by tool_library::an_export_name_without_a_suffix_gets_the_library_extension.

Refs #300
